title: dasasikkhāpada
credit: English: course exercise book, after Piyadassi Thera’s translation (accesstoinsight.org).

paras.en: I undertake the training rule of abstaining from killing living creatures.
I undertake the training rule of abstaining from taking what has not been given.
I undertake the training rule of abstaining from sensual misconduct.
I undertake the training rule of abstaining from false speech.
I undertake the training rule of abstaining from liquor, wines, or intoxicants which cause heedlessness.
